entities.summary: Bisila Bokoko is a Spanish-born American businesswoman. She is the founder and CEO of BBES a New York-based business development agency that represents, promotes and markets brands internationally. Prior to starting her company, she held the position of executive director of the Spain-US Chamber of Commerce in New York City from 2005 to 2012.
